title: Cows swallow… then bring it back up for more 🐄
caption:
Chewing the same lunch all day. Respect 🐄😅
Tag someone who chews slowly 👇
first_comment: Did you know cows chew their food twice? 🐄👇
sources: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'ruminant' and 'rumination' (four-chamber stomach; regurgitation and re-chewing of cud)
University extension guidance (e.g. Penn State Extension, Michigan State University Extension): cows ruminate about 7-10 hours a day; rumen holds roughly 150-200 litres; about 40-60 chews per bolus
